unrelated_modified_file_inventoried.note: 83-line addition, unrelated to this mission (a separate live/shadow process's own ledger writes). Not staged, not modified, not committed by this mission.

p1_previous_stop_preserved.note: Not overwritten or reinterpreted. It remains valid evidence that acquisition was correctly attempted before any admissible completed UTC day existed at or after the freshness boundary.

decision_start.note: Matches the earliest_permitted_fresh_start already frozen in HYP_001_EXIT_CAPTURE_PREREGISTRATION.md Section 6. Cannot move forward or backward based on future results.

checkpoint_policy.counting_rule: Calendar-only, strategy-outcome-independent: starting at CONFIRM_001_DECISION_START's calendar date (2026-09-15, a Tuesday), count forward inclusive, one unit per Monday-Friday calendar date (weekday() < 5 in ISO convention), skipping Saturday/Sunday, until 20 such dates are accumulated. No FX-specific bank-holiday calendar is applied at this mechanical-freeze stage (none exists in this repository as a precommitted, symbol-independent list); a date that later turns out to be a known full market closure (e.g. a bank holiday with zero candles) is excluded from the admitted package at acquisition time per mission P3/P6, which may shift the effective admitted day count for that block without altering this frozen 20-weekday TARGET definition itself.
checkpoint_policy.earliest_acquisition_timestamp_derivatio: First UTC instant strictly after TARGET_END_DATE (2026-10-12) is fully complete under the existing GEN_002/FRESH_DATA_ADMISSION 'latest fully completed UTC day' convention -- i.e. the start of 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z.
checkpoint_policy.partial_day_policy: The current partial UTC day is never acquired into CONFIRM_001. Known full market closures encountered during actual acquisition are excluded and reported separately, not silently treated as gaps.
checkpoint_policy.current_true_utc_reference: ~2026-09-15T12:08Z (per BOUNDARY_STATUS.json, broker offset +3h detected via src/mt5/broker_time.py against VantageMarkets-Demo)
checkpoint_policy.checkpoint_reasoning: Current true UTC time (~2026-09-15T12:08Z) is far earlier than EARLIEST_ACQUISITION_TIMESTAMP (2026-10-13T00:00:00Z). No partial package is acquired. This mission acquired zero market data.

market_day_vs_occurrence_N_distinction.market_day_target: 20 completed FX market weekdays -- a prospectively frozen DATA WINDOW size, derived purely from the calendar, before any setup detection.
market_day_vs_occurrence_N_distinction.explicit_statement: These are two independent numbers that happen to share the value 20 by owner choice, not by logical necessity. The market-day count bounds how much calendar time is acquired; the occurrence-N rule (frozen in HYP_001_EXIT_CAPTURE_PREREGISTRATION.md Section 13) bounds whether the PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE decision rule may be applied once a population is later generated from the acquired data. A population generated from a full 20-weekday CONFIRM_001 window could still yield TREATMENT_N < 20 (INCONCLUSIVE_AT_CHECKPOINT_001) or >= 20 (decision rule applies) -- this mission makes no prediction and inspects no setup data to guess which.

extension_policy_governance.existing_preregistration_status: HYP_001_EXIT_CAPTURE_PREREGISTRATION.md Section 7 freezes the GENERAL extension shape (chronological, forward-only, contiguous, non-overlapping, parameter-unchanged, evaluate only after a separately admitted/frozen package) but does NOT freeze an exact block SIZE for extensions beyond checkpoint_1 -- checkpoint_1 itself was described only as 'first frozen, separately-admitted EURUSD data package,' with no day-count specified until this mission mechanically derived one (20 completed FX market weekdays) for CONFIRM_001 specifically.
extension_policy_governance.reasoning: The mission's own P8 instruction requires flagging this rather than silently assuming a size, and forbids defining extension length after observing CONFIRM_001's occurrence N (which has not been, and will not be, observed by this mission).
extension_policy_governance.proposed_extension_block_size_for_owner_: 20 completed FX market weekdays per extension block (matching CONFIRM_001's own size), counted by the identical calendar-only rule above, starting the calendar day immediately after the prior block's last admitted trading date -- PROPOSED ONLY, NOT AUTHORITATIVE. Requires explicit owner approval and, if approved, must be added to HYP_001_EXIT_CAPTURE_PREREGISTRATION.md as a dedicated amendment (new hypothesis-preregistration field, not a silent in-place edit of Section 7's existing text) before it may govern any block beyond CONFIRM_001.
